name: Fake Email Generator
summary: Generate synthetic email addresses for fixtures and mockups — locally in your browser.
description: Create 1–100 fake emails on a domain you choose, or mix example.* domains. Use a seed for reproducible lists and copy plain text or JSON. For development demos only — these are not real mailboxes.

faqs.question: Can I send mail to these addresses?
faqs.answer: No. They are placeholders for UI and API fixtures. Prefer domains like example.com.

faqs.question: Can I reproduce the same list?
Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
